name: Allow Importing Subs from Local Storage

needles: Allow Importing Subs from Local Storage

focusedTests: isolated x86_64 and universal exclusive-mode application
acceptance: Settings > Morphe > Subtitles exposes an enabled-by-default Allow Importing Subs from Local Storage switch that controls the feature
The subtitle language rail shows Local Storage immediately after None while ExoPlayer is active
Local Storage shows a Choose subtitle file action before imported files
Choosing the action keeps the subtitle overlay open behind Android's document picker without broad storage permission
SRT, VTT, WebVTT, ASS, SSA, TTML and DFXP files up to 10 MB can be imported into private app storage
Returning from the picker immediately shows the imported row selected in Local Storage and activates it in playback
Choose subtitle file never displays a selected tick; the imported row does
While an imported subtitle is active, no native subtitle row retains a second selected tick
Repeated D-pad focus changes and overlay recomposition never duplicate imported rows or increase the Local Storage count
Imported rows show the detected language as the primary title and exact filename as light secondary text
The first imported-row selection loads supported local sidecar text from patch-private storage and preserves playback position and play state
Selecting a supported local sidecar does not rebuild the playing media source, and restoration runs once per player controller and content key
Reopening the subtitle overlay restores usable D-pad focus without changing the active local subtitle
Subtitle style and delay controls remain available for the imported subtitle
The active imported subtitle is restored for the same movie or episode after leaving and reopening playback
An imported row is available only to its owning movie or exact season and episode and is absent from every other playback
The same source filename can be imported independently for different videos without replacing another video's private copy
Import ownership and cross-content isolation survive an app restart
Private imported files expire after seven days without that movie or episode being watched
Imported selections remain patch-private and are not written to Nuvio sync or its addon subtitle preference
A filename SDH marker is not misread as Southern Kurdish; Mark SDH Subtitles displays it immediately
Mark SDH Subtitles scans English local files in the background when no explicit marker exists
Remove SDH Annotations processes imported Media3 cues under its existing mode
The original selected file is never modified
Local Storage is omitted for MPV and no imported subtitle is sent to MPV
No crash, ANR, VerifyError or fatal log occurs during picker launch, import, selection, seeking or exit
